title: Measures to Prevent Speeding and Reckless Driving Especially at Accident-prone Junctions
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent Speeding and Reckless Driving Especially at Accident-prone Junctions

sections.label: RAG arrows, School and Silver Zones
sections.summary: LTA has replaced discretionary right turns with RAG arrows at over 1,200 junctions, and implemented 371 School Zones and 40 Silver Zones as of 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since 2018, LTA has progressively implemented Red-Amber-Green (RAG) arrows to replace discretionary right turns at over 1,200 traffic junctions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Junctions with RAG arrows have shown a 40% reduction in traffic accidents.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As of 2023, we have implemented 371 School Zones and 40 Silver Zones in areas near schools and where there are higher proportions of senior residents.

sections.label: Silver Zone and Friendly Streets
sections.summary: Silver Zones cut senior pedestrian accidents by about 80%, with five pilot sites in 2023, 10 more in 2024, and Friendly Streets aimed at all towns by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Silver Zone initiative has proven effective in reducing the accident rate among senior pedestrians within the zones by about 80%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Besides the usual traffic calming measures, there will also be more frequent Green Man activations and longer crossing time to allow pedestrians, especially the elderly, to cross the road safely at these areas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We started with five pilot sites in 2023 and will begin engagements on a further 10 sites in 2024, with the aim of bringing Friendly Streets to all towns by 2030.

sections.label: Higher composition fines for offences
sections.summary: The first composition fine, even for a first offence, has risen from $500 to $1,000, and first offenders may be charged in court for egregious violations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The first composition fine, even for the first offence, has increased from $500 to $1,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And even for first offenders, if they are egregious violations, they can be charged in court.

sections.label: RAG rollout at signalised junctions
sections.summary: Of 1,700 signalised junctions, 200 have no discretionary right turn, RAG is implemented at over 1,200 of the 1,500, and another 200 are being studied.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: First, let me say that for RAGs, as I have said, we have implemented this for more than 1,200 signalised junctions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There are a total of 1,700 signalised junctions, of which for 200, there is no discretionary right turn.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of these 1,500, we have implemented RAG in more than 1,200.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are in the process of looking into implementing RAG for another 200 junctions, though this depends on technical feasibility as well as traffic impact assessment studies.

sections.label: Junction safety and accident review
sections.summary: Between 2019 and 2023 there were no serious injury or fatal accidents at that junction, and no further safety measures are thought needed pending TP's investigation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Between 2019 and 2023, there were also no accidents with serious injuries or fatalities at that junction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we have designed such junctions in accordance with international standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also reviewed the junction after the accident and we do not think that there is a need to further enhance or implement measures to enhance safety at that junction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But having said that, we will also await TP's investigation, for the results of the investigation, and will review again if measures have to be implemented to enhance road safety.

sections.label: School road safety mitigation measures
sections.summary: Measures include enforcement against illegal parking, wider footpaths, directing students to signalised pedestrian crossings, and railings in some schools.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As well as, if needed, we will have enforcement for illegal parking; create wider footpaths; or even direct students to specially created, signalised pedestrian crossings, and put up railings in some schools as mitigation measures.
